tools.label: Stretch
tools.detail: Crossing-box stretch of LINE and polyline/spline vertices; fully enclosed supported objects move. No solid stretching.

tools.label: Multiline Text
tools.detail: Plain multiline text; rich text formatting is not supported. DXF export emits MTEXT.

tools.label: Leader
tools.detail: Creates a static arrow, line and text block. No associative multileader style system.

tools.label: Table
tools.detail: Creates a block of lines and text. No formulas, linked cells or native CAD TABLE semantics.

tools.label: Attribute Definition
tools.detail: Block attributes need entity, editor and interchange support.

tools.label: Lineweight
tools.detail: Edits the selected objects' layer lineweight; all entities on those layers are affected.

tools.label: Transparency
tools.detail: Object transparency (0–90 percent), preserved by cloning and native files; displayed in 2D/PDF and exported to DXF. Does not control saved 3D solid materials.

tools.label: Measure
tools.detail: Opens the measurement tool palette; MEASURE point placement is not implemented.

tools.label: Quick Measure
tools.detail: Click an entity to report its measurements; no live hover overlay.

tools.label: Write Block
tools.detail: Writes selected model-space entities and their block/layer/style dependencies to a native project or 2D DXF.

tools.label: Attach DWG
tools.detail: DWG opening is available through an optional ODA converter. Linked DWG references are not implemented.

tools.label: Attach PDF
tools.detail: This format is not supported by the current importer. Use DXF for supported 2D geometry.

tools.label: Attach DGN
tools.detail: This format is not supported by the current importer. Use DXF for supported 2D geometry.

tools.label: Attach Image
tools.detail: Raster underlay persistence, transforms and plotting are not implemented.

tools.label: Attach Point Cloud
tools.detail: Requires a point-cloud importer and spatial rendering engine.

tools.label: External References
tools.detail: Lists cached DXF references and reloads them. Nested-reference dependency packaging is not implemented.

tools.label: Attach DXF
tools.detail: 2D DXF references only; inspect import warnings before use.

tools.label: PDF Import
tools.detail: This format is not supported by the current importer. Use DXF for supported 2D geometry.

tools.label: DGN Import
tools.detail: This format is not supported by the current importer. Use DXF for supported 2D geometry.

tools.label: Markup Import
tools.detail: Markup recognition and association are not implemented.

tools.label: Data Extraction
tools.detail: Exports a static CSV of selected or visible model entities and their measured properties.

tools.label: Extract Data table
tools.detail: Creates a block of lines and text. No formulas, linked cells or native CAD TABLE semantics.

tools.label: Hyperlink
tools.detail: Edit/remove HTTP(S) entity links and explicitly open them. Native and supported DXF entities preserve links; file paths and executable URL schemes are excluded.

tools.label: Multiline Text
tools.detail: Plain multiline text; no inline rich formatting.

tools.label: Spell Check
tools.detail: Requires a dictionary-backed spelling engine.

tools.label: Angular
tools.detail: Angular dimension entities, editing and interchange are not implemented.

tools.label: Arc Length
tools.detail: Arc-length dimension entities are not implemented.

tools.label: Continue
tools.detail: Select a linear dimension, then specify extension points. New dimensions are independent.

tools.label: Baseline
tools.detail: Select a linear dimension, then specify extension points. New dimensions are independent.

tools.label: Centerline
tools.detail: Creates ordinary editable geometry; not associative with the source. Pick two parallel lines.

tools.label: Center Mark
tools.detail: Creates ordinary editable geometry; not associative with the source. Pick a circle or arc.

tools.label: Multileader
tools.detail: Creates a static arrow, line and text block. No associative multileader style system. One leader branch.

tools.label: Add Leader
tools.detail: Persistent multileader branch editing is not implemented.

tools.label: Remove Leader
tools.detail: Persistent multileader branch editing is not implemented.

tools.label: Table
tools.detail: Creates a block of lines and text. No formulas, linked cells or native CAD TABLE semantics.

tools.label: Table Style
tools.detail: Sets cell size and text height for newly created static table blocks; not a named CAD style table.

tools.label: Coincident
tools.detail: Persistent coincidence of LINE endpoints, POINTs or CIRCLE/ARC centers. Native .pycad persistence; bounded 2D solver, no polyline segments, blocks, solids or expression parameters.

tools.label: Collinear
tools.detail: Persistent collinearity between two LINE entities. Native .pycad persistence; bounded 2D solver, no polyline segments, blocks, solids or expression parameters.

tools.label: Concentric
tools.detail: Persistent common center for CIRCLE/ARC entities. Native .pycad persistence; bounded 2D solver, no polyline segments, blocks, solids or expression parameters.

tools.label: Fixed
tools.detail: Locks the complete position/shape of a LINE, POINT, CIRCLE or ARC. Native .pycad persistence; bounded 2D solver, no polyline segments, blocks, solids or expression parameters.

tools.label: Parallel
tools.detail: Maintains parallel LINE directions after committed edits. Native .pycad persistence; bounded 2D solver, no polyline segments, blocks, solids or expression parameters.

tools.label: Perpendicular
tools.detail: Maintains perpendicular LINE directions after committed edits. Native .pycad persistence; bounded 2D solver, no polyline segments, blocks, solids or expression parameters.

tools.label: Linear
tools.detail: Driving X or Y distance between LINE endpoints, POINTs or CIRCLE/ARC centers. Enter X/Y to choose the component. Native .pycad persistence; bounded 2D solver, no polyline segments, blocks, solids or expression parameters.

tools.label: Aligned
tools.detail: Driving distance between supported endpoints/centers. Native .pycad persistence; bounded 2D solver, no polyline segments, blocks, solids or expression parameters.

tools.label: Angular
tools.detail: Driving angle between LINE entities, greater than 0 and less than 180 degrees. Native .pycad persistence; bounded 2D solver, no polyline segments, blocks, solids or expression parameters.

tools.label: Radius
tools.detail: Driving CIRCLE/ARC radius. Native .pycad persistence; bounded 2D solver, no polyline segments, blocks, solids or expression parameters.

tools.label: Diameter
tools.detail: Driving CIRCLE/ARC diameter. Native .pycad persistence; bounded 2D solver, no polyline segments, blocks, solids or expression parameters.

tools.label: Show/Hide All
tools.detail: Shows/hides persistent constraint labels in drafting; labels are not printed. Native .pycad persistence; bounded 2D solver, no polyline segments, blocks, solids or expression parameters.

tools.label: Delete Constraints
tools.detail: Removes constraints involving selected objects, or asks before removing all. Undo restores them. Native .pycad persistence; bounded 2D solver, no polyline segments, blocks, solids or expression parameters.

tools.label: Settings
tools.detail: Constraint manager: edit driving values, delete relations, view remaining degrees of freedom, and configure tolerance/labels. Native .pycad persistence; bounded 2D solver, no polyline segments, blocks, solids or expression parameters.

tools.label: Zoom Window
tools.detail: Two-corner window in the 2D drafting viewport.

tools.label: Zoom Realtime
tools.detail: Drag vertically in the 2D viewport; 3D also supports wheel zoom.

tools.label: SteeringWheel
tools.detail: PyCAD's compact in-viewport navigation rail and view selector; not Autodesk's SteeringWheel.

tools.label: Base View
tools.detail: Generated associative drawing views from solids are not implemented.

tools.label: Projected View
tools.detail: Generated drawing views are not the same as the existing model camera presets.

tools.label: Section
tools.detail: Requires solid sectioning and drawing-view generation.

tools.label: Detail
tools.detail: Requires associative drawing-view generation.

tools.label: Conceptual
tools.detail: A conceptual material/edge renderer is not implemented.

tools.label: Realistic
tools.detail: Material, texture, lighting and shadow rendering are not implemented.

tools.label: Shaded
tools.detail: Software shaded faces with edges; no material lighting.

tools.label: X-Ray
tools.detail: Transparent faces and edges in the embedded model viewport.

tools.label: Tool Palettes
tools.detail: Searchable command/capability palette; no drag-and-drop reusable block library.

tools.label: Sheet Set Manager
tools.detail: Sheet-set databases, publishing and drawing links are not implemented.

tools.label: Check
tools.detail: Check drawing units and layer names/colors/linetypes/lineweights against a configured native JSON profile. No Autodesk DWS support or automatic repair.

tools.label: Configure
tools.detail: Capture/load/save a native PyCAD standards profile; the active profile persists in .pycad. DWS files are not supported.

tools.label: Standards
tools.detail: Manage a persistent PyCAD JSON standards profile and run a drawing check. Not an Autodesk DWS engine.

tools.label: Layer Translator
tools.detail: Merge a source layer into an existing target, including block geometry and saved extrusion layer references. Undo restores both tables and objects. No saved mapping-file library.

tools.label: User Interface (CUI)
tools.detail: A full CUI editor is not implemented. Use the Compact ribbon toggle and Edit Aliases.

tools.label: Action Recorder
tools.detail: Replayable command/coordinate recording is not implemented.

tools.label: Load Application (AutoLISP/VBA)
tools.detail: AutoLISP and VBA runtimes are not implemented. Python console remains available from the menu.

tools.label: Visual Basic Editor
tools.detail: No VBA runtime or editor is included.

tools.label: Action Macro
tools.detail: Command macro recording/replay is not implemented.

tools.label: Plot
tools.detail: Vector PDF plotting with model scale or paper layouts. Direct physical-printer selection is not implemented.

tools.label: Batch Plot
tools.detail: Exports one PDF per paper layout into a ZIP (or Model when no layouts exist).

tools.label: Plot Preview
tools.detail: Preview of the current space using the same PDF renderer as export.

tools.label: Page Setup
tools.detail: Changes the current paper layout's width/height in millimetres; Model uses A4 landscape.

tools.label: DWF
tools.detail: A DWF exporter is not implemented.

tools.label: DXF
tools.detail: Supported 2D entities only; dimensions export as lines/text. 3D extrusion export is rejected.

tools.label: STL
tools.detail: Exports one selected closed 2D profile with a prompted extrusion height; requires optional CadQuery.

tools.label: FBX
tools.detail: An FBX scene exporter is not implemented.

tools.label: Email
tools.detail: Email account integration is not implemented. Save an eTransmit package and attach it manually.

tools.label: Transmittal (eTransmit)
tools.detail: Creates a local ZIP of the native drawing and direct DXF reference files with a manifest; missing references abort packaging.
